structured_output.title: New certificate metrics will be exposed to active Prometheus
structured_output.content: The environment has Prometheus ServiceMonitor enabled (`prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled` set with `prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort` configured), which means cert-manager metrics are actively scraped. The v1.18.0 release adds two new metrics: `certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds` and `certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds`. These metrics will automatically appear in the Prometheus scrape target after upgrade. Inspect whether your Prometheus instance, dashboards, and alert rules should be updated to use or handle these new metrics.
